Question 3
?

Given P(A)=14, P(B)=310, and P(A∪B)=1940, determine whether A and B are mutually exclusive events.

a
A and B are not mutually exclusive events, since P(A)⋅P(B)<P(A∪B)
b
A and B are not mutually exclusive events, since P(A)⋅P(B)≠P(A∪B)
c
A and B are not mutually exclusive events, since P(A∩B)≠0
d
A and B are not mutually exclusive events, since P(A)≠P(B)
e
A and B are mutually exclusive events, since P(A∩B)=0
